categories.Primate atlas: Primate hypothalamic population atlas and its registered comparison.
categories.Diet-induced obesity: Diet interventions and obesity-related hypothalamic expression comparisons.
categories.Feeding & fasting: Food availability, feeding state and nutrition comparisons.
categories.Microbiome & gut–brain axis: Microbial or metabolite interventions with a hypothalamic readout.
categories.Reproduction & development: Reproductive and developmental comparisons in the profiled animal.
categories.Developmental programming: Maternal metabolic exposures measured in offspring; inspect the actual contrast.
categories.Aging: Direct chronological-age comparisons, excluding interventions merely performed in aged animals.
categories.Circadian: Clock, light, sleep and timed-expression studies; time-series capability is track-specific.

contracts.FeatureType: Distinguishes gene rows from miRNA rows.
contracts.Group: Experimental arm identity, label and color.
contracts.Contrast: Declared baseline-to-case comparison and its interpretation flags.
contracts.Dataset: Registered study/modality and the locations and capabilities of its bundles.
contracts.ResolvedContrast: A comparison resolved to its experimental arms for display and loading.
contracts.QCFlags: Track quality flags and supporting measurements.
contracts.DatasetMeta: Dataset-level track inventory, labels and sample metadata.
contracts.QcGlobal: Dataset QC payload consumed by the QC views.
contracts.GeneDERecord: Precomputed differential-expression statistics for one feature.
contracts.PathwayRecord: Precomputed enrichment result and leading-edge information.
contracts.PathwayRecordWithDb: Enrichment result annotated with its database.
contracts.PathwaySibling: Separately loaded pathway payload, including comparison-specific results.
contracts.TrackMeta: Metadata describing a loaded expression track.
contracts.TrackQC: Quality information attached to a track payload.
contracts.CpmMatrix: Feature-to-sample value arrays; consult expressionUnit rather than assuming CPM.
contracts.RawTrack: Loaded track bundle before the UI transform.
contracts.PopData: Resolved, UI-ready view of one track and comparison.
contracts.Direction: Display direction relative to the selected contrast.
contracts.TrackRow: One track's gene result in a cross-dataset report.
contracts.CrossDatasetGeneReport: Per-study gene results and report metadata; interpretation policy stays with consumers.
contracts.GroupSummary: Expression summary for one experimental arm.
contracts.PathwayTrackRow: One track's pathway result in a cross-dataset report.
contracts.CrossDatasetPathwayReport: Per-study enrichment results and report metadata.
contracts.ReviewStatus: Dataset intake-board progress states, separate from scientific verification.
contracts.Reviews: Intake review records keyed by identity.
contracts.TrackerRow: Dataset intake record exposed to the tracker.
contracts.TimeSeriesMatrix: Feature values aligned to time-series sample order.
contracts.TimeSeriesBundle: Separately loaded time-series metadata and expression values.
contracts.TimeSeriesDescriptor: Registry declaration identifying time-series tracks and bundle locations.
contracts.ExpressionCondition: Source condition, reference eligibility and explicitly reported biological state.
contracts.ExpressionProvider: External atlas publisher, release, licence and the attribution shown with its values.
contracts.ExpressionSource: Expression-only source identity, material, provenance, measurement scale, sample groups and, for atlases, value kind and provider.
contracts.ExpressionSampleValue: One original sample label and its stored measurement or missing value.
contracts.ExpressionGroupResult: Within-source condition measurements and arithmetic mean on the stored scale, or a provider's published summary value.
contracts.ExpressionGeneResult: Resolved expression query, distinguishing available, absent and ambiguous features.

relationships: Registry declarations identify studies; bundle loaders and transforms provide the selected track and contrast to views.
Analysis and evidence checks govern scientific data; context checks govern navigation and reviewed documentation freshness.
The site Worker serves assets; R2 serves bundles behind edge cache and WAF rules, and a scheduled spend guard caps R2 reads.
